findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Improper SSL certificate validation
 * @description Missing or improper SSL certificate validation can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/improper-ssl-validation
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-295
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember(["create_default_context"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("_create_unverified_context").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("ssl").getMember("SSLContext").getACall()
select call, "SSL context creation that may have improper certificate validation."
findings.hypothesis: Improper SSL certificate validation allowing MITM attacks
